author: reek
body: PBR with a textured albedo. A single rotating sphere is ray-cast; the hit point maps to spherical (u, v) coordinates that index a procedural tile texture, and that albedo feeds a Cook-Torrance shade (GGX + Smith + Fresnel) under an orbiting key light. Reference site's "PBR texture" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: A tile pattern in (u, v): coloured tiles with dark grout, plus a per-tile tint.
